name: goal-dag
description: Local-first goal DAG orchestration for branching, merging, and multi-trunk work.

interface.shortDescription: Branch, merge, and coordinate long-horizon goals.
interface.longDescription: Manage a long-horizon goal from Codex chat. Add branches, merge them into decision gates, update status, and let the assistant expand the graph autonomously when authorized.
defaultPrompt: Create a goal DAG for this project.
Merge these branches into a decision gate.
Show the next ready goal nodes.
